test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
Select the options that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

I said, “I took a lot of precautions after my surgery.”

options.text: I said that I have taken a lot of precautions after my surgery.
I said that I had taken a lot of precautions after my surgery.
I said that I will take a lot of precautions after my surgery.
I said that I took a lot of precautions after my surgery.

solution:
The correct answer is **"I said that I had taken a lot of precautions after my surgery."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Structure for this type of reported speech:

 
 
• ​**Past Indefinite changes** into **Past Perfect Tense**.

 
 
• **Example:**
 **Direct Narration**: You said, “She sent me a mail ”.
 Past Tense Past Indefinite Tense
 **Indirect Narration**: You said that she had sent it.
 
 
 
 

**Hence, the correct sentence will be:** *I said that I **had taken** a lot of precautions after my surgery.*
